description: This file defines the VTExpressionsManager class, which handles expression functions, field metadata retrieval for modules, and caching mechanisms within the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: VTExpressionsManager
classes.description: A class managing expression functions, field descriptions for modules, and caching within the vtiger CRM platform.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a database connection.

methods.name: addToCache
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the static cache.

methods.name: fromCache
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the cache by key, or returns false if not found.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears all entries from the cache.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Retrieves and returns an array of field labels indexed by field names for a given module.

methods.name: expressionFunctions
methods.description: Returns an array of predefined expression functions with their usage examples.
